evidence: The chemical bonding states of ErxTi1-xOy films were probed with a high resolution XPS. The bulk composition of the resulting films was investigated using Rutherford back scattering (RBS) spectroscopy. An X-ray diffractometer (X’pert, PANalytical, BN Co.) was used to obtain glancing incidence X-ray diffraction (GIXRD) patterns. Film thickness was measured with a spectral ellipsometer. Surface morphology of as-deposited and RTP-treated films was investigated using a noncontact optical proﬁler system in the phase-shifting interferometry (PSI) mode. Current density-voltage (J-V) and capacitance-voltage (C-V) characterizations were performed using an Agilent 4980 LCR meter. The interface-thickness of RTP-treated films was measured with spectral ellipsometry and transmission electron microscopy.
